verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's own docs say it helps users find results 'instantly' and pair it with React InstantSearch for responsive search interfaces. Community users report fast search, but one hands-on check measured ~360ms on a Meilisearch-powered site, which questions the millisecond-per-keystroke claim without concretely disproving it for the engine. missing for 10: first-party documentation of as-you-type/search-on-every-keystroke behavior, documented millisecond latency figures for full-text search, independent latency benchmarks confirming sub-100ms responses.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deliver as-you-type instant search with millisecond responses so results update on every keystroke

citations.quote: Help users find what they want instantly, even when they misspell or only remember part of it.
Build performant, responsive search interfaces by pairing Meilisearch with React InstantSearch.
Indexing was about 10x faster and search at least 3x faster, with literally zero config.
